source: make a football game with a big stadium

image_prompt.text: Touchlines and end lines drawn around the football pitch, built so a script can pause or reset play the moment the ball crosses them
Marked restart positions on the pitch, a centre spot and kickoff marks the ball and players reset to in order to start play
Goal mouths at each end of the pitch, engineered to register points when the ball crosses the line
Painted yard and distance lines across the grass denoting spatial progress along the field
Large tiered seating wrapping the pitch on all sides, giving the big stadium its scale and visually enclosing the map
The outer stadium wall closing the ground off and containing the ball and players

layout_placement.text: A detection perimeter on the touchlines and end lines so play pauses or resets the microsecond the ball crosses
Static restart positions for the ball and players at the centre spot and kickoff marks
Scoring volumes in each goal mouth that register a point when the ball passes through

notes: spectator-bleachers carries P0 + tiered: the seating height must be captured or the stadium builds completely flat.
Field specs are fixed and public, so parametric placement of the pitch beats free image generation here - a generator choice, not a routing change.
The prompt does not say which football code is meant; pitch proportions and goal geometry differ between association football and gridiron.
